$comment: Manual overrides on top of the automatic stablecoin/wrapped filtering. See docs/SPEC.md section 2.2.
$denyTagsNote: Exact tag equality only. 'stablecoin-protocol' must NOT match - ENA, SKY, FF are real trend assets.
$denyNote: CoinGecko coin ids to always exclude, e.g. tokenized RWA funds and exchange tokens.
$allowNote: CoinGecko coin ids to always keep, overriding every automatic exclusion.
